errors.where: rope knot on the tree trunk above the feeder
errors.what: The hanging rope is knotted flat against the front of the bark, and the rope above the knot runs up into the trunk. It never wraps around the trunk or a branch, so nothing actually holds the feeder up.
The left end shows a gable (peaked) profile, but the planks on top read as one flat, single-slope slab. The two roof shapes don't agree.

cards.fix: Loop the hanging rope fully around a sturdy branch so it is clearly tied around it, and give the feeder a clean two-sided gable roof whose planks meet at a ridge.

errors.what: The two arms don't mirror each other: the left fluke tip curls up into a tall hook, while the right fluke is flatter and shaped differently.

cards.fix: Make the anchor's two arms and flukes exact mirror images of each other.

errors.what: The two soles are the same shape facing the same way, so the pair reads as two of the same foot rather than a left and a right.

cards.fix: Show a mirrored left and right pair of flip-flops, with each sole's shape and strap angle mirrored.

errors.what: The louver flap looks like a separate bar floating in front of the vent opening, and its right end sticks out past the housing with no hinge or mount.

cards.fix: Set the louver flap inside the vent opening, hinged at both ends to the housing sides.

errors.where: headphone headband where it meets the controller's front edge
errors.what: The top of the headband and its cyan slider seem to merge into the front edge of the DJ controller instead of resting against it or in front of it.

cards.fix: Place the headphones fully in front of the DJ controller with a small gap, so the headband is clearly separate from the controller body.
